create_SynthIDLogitsProcessor: create a SynthIDLogitsProcessor instance for watermarking transformer model outputs with configurable ngram length and keys
update_scores: update logit scores using g values to apply watermarking bias during text generation
update_scores_distortionary: update logit scores using distortionary tournament method with configurable number of leaves per node
compute_g_values: compute g values for each ngram from a given sequence of token ids for watermark analysis
compute_context_repetition_mask: compute a mask identifying repeated n-1 gram contexts to avoid redundant watermarking
